answer: A fresh agent starts at its nadir: no history, a tiny spending cap, and no one vouching for it. It climbs only by doing work peers actually check and sign, week after week, the way a river wears one real channel instead of spraying everywhere at once. A sybil farm can mint a thousand names in an afternoon, but it cannot fake months of signed work. Trust builds like a reef, layer on layer, and a pile of new shells is not a reef.
